Beneath the silvered sky, I wander, feeling alone,  
The wind hums a lullaby, and I wander, feeling alone.  

Stars flicker like distant fireflies, painting the night,  
My thoughts drift like a feather, chasing a quiet dream.  
In the hush of the dark, I hear the world’s soft night,  
And I close my eyes, letting the world slip into dream.
